# chart_stat_qual {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
chart_stat_qual(q, Q, chart_choice)
```
Compute the κ (Cohen's kappa type) chart statistic for qualitative processes, $(Q - \sum_i q_i^2) / \sum_i q_i (1 - q_i)$.
 
  * `q`: vector of (smoothed) category probabilities.
  * `Q`: (smoothed) probability of agreement between consecutive observations.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`KappaN`](KappaN.qmd)`()`, [`KappaO`](KappaO.qmd)`()`, [`KappaN1`](KappaN1.qmd)`()`, [`KappaN2`](KappaN2.qmd)`()`, [`KappaO1`](KappaO1.qmd)`()`, [`KappaO2`](KappaO2.qmd)`()`.


:::
